definitions: To tie, fasten, or secure with rope.
To enclose or separate an area with rope.
To catch or lasso with a rope.
To persuade or trick someone into doing something.
To climb or descend using a rope.
examples: They roped the boat to the dock.
The police roped off the crime scene.
She roped him into helping with the project.
The climbers roped down the cliff.
